primitives.name: Hough Lines
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Hough Lines** to find the field's white lines, drop superfluous detections with heuristics, then rotate the frame so lines are perpendicular.
primitives.assumptions: Euclidean image plane, line parametrization in polar coordinates ($\rho$, $\theta$), Hough voting threshold set heuristically to filter noise.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails when stadium lighting casts shadows that mimic white-line intensity, or when camera angle introduces perspective distortion beyond planar correction.

layer2.mapping: Rectification kernel; maps physical camera perspective to an affine planar projection where geometric features (lines, angles) become linear separable.
layer2.telemetry: Residual mean squared error between predicted and actual rotated frame coordinates; sharp increase signals rectification failure.

primitives.name: Jersey Colour Segmentation
primitives.verbatim_quote: Line of scrimmage located by proximity to the offensive line; players detected by **jersey colour analysis** (e.g.
primitives.assumptions: RGB color space linearity, consistent marker placement across frames, and distinct color clusters for each team (e.g., burgundy vs. white).
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks down under uniform jerseys, dark uniforms against dark backgrounds, or when markers are occluded by other players.

layer2.mapping: Binary classification filter; projects high-dimensional RGB space onto a 1D color histogram threshold to isolate player presence.
layer2.telemetry: Intersection over union (IoU) score between ground-truth bounding boxes and predicted jersey segments; low IoU indicates misclassification.

primitives.name: CART Classification
primitives.verbatim_quote: Per-feature classifiers run **independently** (QB alignment, RB/WR/TE counts and locations), the formation derived from the sum of the parts.
primitives.assumptions: Independence assumption between feature classifiers, recursive binary splitting on Gini impurity, and fixed maximum depth to prevent overfitting.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularity occurs when training data exhibits severe class imbalance (e.g., Pistol formation with only 12% recall), causing bias towards majority classes.

layer2.mapping: Ensemble combinatorial operator; aggregates multiple binary decision trees into a joint probability distribution over possible offensive formations.
layer2.telemetry: Formation accuracy metrics (precision, recall) on held-out test sets; sharp drop in minority-class recall flags imbalance issues.

reasoning_traces.think:
The core challenge is converting noisy, variable-resolution All-22 film into stable, pre-snap formation data. The three primitives form a compositional pipeline: HoughLines corrects for camera perspective and stadium geometry, producing a standardized coordinate system. JerseyColourSegmentation then isolates individual players within that system, leveraging persistent visual markers (uniform colors). Finally, CARTClassification independently categorizes each player's role (quarterback, receiver, etc.) and combines these local labels into a global formation vector. The method's strength lies in its modularity—each step can be independently evaluated and improved. However, its Achilles heel is the independence assumption in CART, which fails catastrophically when rare events (like the Pistol formation) lack sufficient training samples. This leads to severe class imbalance, where the model prioritizes common formations at the expense of rare ones. To mitigate this, future work should incorporate resampling techniques or cost-sensitive learning to balance the minority classes.
